title: Inquest set for man who died in police custody in Kelowna
article: A date has been set for an inquest into the death of a man who died while in police custody at Kelowna General Hospital.
Brandt Jason Zimmer, 40, died at the hospital emergency ward on August 15, 2010.
The inquest will take place from June 4 to 7, 2012 at the Kelowna courthouse.
Zimmer had been taken to KGH by officers shortly after his arrest at a Kelowna amusement centre.
Coroner Rodrick Mackenzie and a jury will hear evidence from witnesses to determine the facts surrounding his death.
